exposure: sonographic assessment of the hysterotomy scar
thickness of the myometrium at the thinnest part of the scar area
visibility of the scar at the first-trimester scan
visibility of the scar at the second-trimester scan
outcome: Successful vaginal birth after Cesarean delivery (VBAC)
Trial of labor after Cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
cohort: Non-pregnant women aged 18-35 years who had undergone one previous low-transverse Cesarean delivery at ≥ 37 gestational weeks and had had no other uterine surgery
finding: The prediction model, based on sonographic assessment of the hysterotomy scar, demonstrated poor accuracy for prediction of successful VBAC in this Swedish population.
